_read_me: Dates of each tax season, keyed by TAX YEAR (the year the income was earned; filing is the next spring).
jan = senders must furnish W-2 and most 1099s · feb = 1099-B and a few others · file = return due. Each already rolled to the next business day.
Source: https://www.irs.gov/filing/individuals/when-to-file . Only list a year when the IRS moves a date; missing years are worked out by rule in the app.
The app drops this whole file if any row is bad.
